face.text: Battlecry: Add one of each Dream card to your hand.

face.text: Get all 5 Dream cards. If you've played a higher Cost card while holding this, corrupt them!

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

new_dependency_fact_source: No new dependencies:five existing full Dream definitions and actual one/all delivery recipes preserved;four sources each declare the same full childIds in both official languages.
policies: Original Ysera own end requests two independent complete five-card finite draws with replacement.
Ysera Dreamer battlecry requests all five once in an automatic uniform permutation and reuses the actual Shaladrassil ordered delivery callback;overflow follows original AddToHand policy.
Naralex enters Dormant2 and only its dormant controller-end declaration reuses the actual Hopeful Dryad single Dream callback. No new turn clock or dormant counter.
All five existing definitions/metadata and existing eight-ID Ysera exclusion family remain exact;both newly implemented Ysera faces were already excluded by Awakens.

Finite recipes are already executable in the standard host and do not use generic collectible/class filters or require another registered context pool. All original five IDs/order/roles/unit weights retained.
uncertainties: Precise CN source timing,random ordering and existing eight-face Ysera exclusion remain explicit local policies pending calibration.
Dream05e is original enchantment evidence,not an unimplemented physical hand card;do not add a fake independent definition.
Full732 past identities retained independently from native coverage;MIS_701 unbound and other source domains/version/hotfix/CN boundaries remain open.
